The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes, including a new case for cancelled orders.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, around line 6514): added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the purchase-order category report uses. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added a `purchaseOrder` overload that takes a status, and a test `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`. It has one sent order per region and two cancelled ones, and expects `Anna:1, Bob:1`.

Nothing is committed.
